resources.string: Allow notification access to show messages, calendar reminders and media controls here. Notifications stay on this phone.

Opens jotterknocker notifications when you pull down from the very top of the home screen. The touch strip is removed when you leave home. This service does not read screen contents or remap hardware buttons.
Enable notification access first. For a swipe starting above the status bar, enable jotterknocker · Top-edge notifications in Accessibility. Both permissions can be turned off here.
Calendar reminders use Calendar’s notification settings and scheduled alarms. Allow its reminders and background activity in the phone settings.
Open the phone settings to enable notification access or Accessibility.
